ala-kol-trek-guide:
## Walk it with us
Want a local guide, packhorses and a hot-spring finish? The pass is part of our [Song-Kul to Ala-Kul ride and trek (7 days)](tour.html?slug=song-kul-horse-trek-ala-kul-hike-7-days) and of the [Kyrgyzstan Grand Tour (10 days)](tour.html?slug=kyrgyzstan-grand-tour-10-days). If the climb sounds like too much, [Kilemche and Song-Kul ride with a trek (6 days)](tour.html?slug=kilemche-song-kul-altyn-arashan-6-days) treks the gentler Altyn-Arashan valley instead.
best-time-to-visit-kyrgyzstan:
## Match the season to a trip
Coming in summer? Ride to [Song-Kul on horseback (3 days)](tour.html?slug=song-kul-horse-trek-3-days) while the jailoo is green. From November to April we run our only [winter ride to a frozen Song-Kul (3 days)](tour.html?slug=winter-horse-trek-to-song-kul-3-days). For the shoulder months, the [Issyk-Kul road trip (4 days)](tour.html?slug=issyk-kul-altyn-arashan-4-days) runs from April right into November.
yurt-culture-etiquette:
## Sleep in one, not just read about it
Every Song-Kul trip stays with real herder families. Start small with [Song-Kul on horseback (2 days)](tour.html?slug=song-kul-overnight-horse-trek-2-days), or live the daily rhythm on the [authentic horseback tour (5 days)](tour.html?slug=mai-tor-pastures-horse-trek-5-days) with yurt and shepherd-house nights.
real-local-guides:
## Meet them on the trail
Our guides shine brightest on the long rides: a full week in the saddle on the [horseback riding tour (7 days)](tour.html?slug=two-lakes-kok-bulak-horse-trek-7-days), or far off the map on the [untouched mountains ride (6 days)](tour.html?slug=ichke-tor-lake-horse-trek-6-days).
tailor-made-trips:
## Start shaping yours
Use the [trip builder](builder.html) to sketch your dates and interests, or take a base like the [Complete Kyrgyzstan Adventure (12 days)](tour.html?slug=complete-kyrgyzstan-adventure-12-days) and bend it to fit. Short on time? [Kyrgyzstan in a week (7 days)](tour.html?slug=song-kul-kel-suu-in-a-week-7-days) packs the icons into seven days.
safety-in-the-mountains:
## Comfortable first steps
If you want the mountains with a soft landing, the [family tour (4 days)](tour.html?slug=family-tour-lakes-eagles-yurts-4-days) and the gentle [easy week by road (7 days)](tour.html?slug=easy-week-song-kul-issyk-kul-7-days) keep the wild scenery and skip the hard passes.
community-tourism:
## Trips built around local homes
The [authentic road trip (8 days)](tour.html?slug=talas-to-issyk-kul-backroads-8-days) sleeps in family guesthouses and nomad camps most tours never reach, and the [untouched mountains ride (6 days)](tour.html?slug=ichke-tor-lake-horse-trek-6-days) stays with herders the whole way.
easy-from-abroad:
## Land, ride, done
Both of these start and end in Bishkek and pack the country into one simple loop: [Kyrgyzstan in a week (7 days)](tour.html?slug=song-kul-kel-suu-in-a-week-7-days) and the faster [express tour (5 days)](tour.html?slug=kel-suu-issyk-kul-express-5-days).
fair-honest-pricing:
## See it in practice
Every tour page lists exactly what's included, day by day: compare the [Song-Kul and Kel-Suu road trip (9 days)](tour.html?slug=song-kul-kel-suu-road-trip-9-days) with the compact [Song-Kul ride and Altyn-Arashan trek (5 days)](tour.html?slug=song-kul-ride-altyn-arashan-trek-5-days) and you'll see the same open pricing on both.
